sections.title: Day 48 學習概覽
sections.markdown:
- 掌握合約修訂、售後保固與海外客戶服務 30 個單字

sections.title: ② 今日文法｜Unless otherwise stated / specified、Once / As soon as + 現在式、Require / insist / recommend that + 原形動詞、Neither...nor 的就近一致、過去反事實倒裝與情態完成式
sections.markdown:
主題：**Unless otherwise stated / specified、Once / As soon as + 現在式、Require / insist / recommend that + 原形動詞、Neither...nor 的就近一致、過去反事實倒裝與情態完成式**

### 規則 1｜Unless otherwise stated / specified

unless otherwise stated 表示「除非另有說明」，常置於句首或句末；stated 為過去分詞。

> Unless otherwise stated, the original cancellation deadline remains in effect.

### 規則 2｜Once / As soon as + 現在式

表未來時間的 once / as soon as 子句通常用現在式，主句可用 will。

> The replacement will be dispatched once the warehouse receives the photos.

### 規則 3｜Require / insist / recommend that + 原形動詞

表示要求、堅持或建議時，that 子句用原形動詞；被動用 be + p.p.。

> The supervisor insisted that every claim be reviewed individually.

### 規則 4｜Neither...nor 的就近一致

neither A nor B 作主詞時，動詞通常與靠近的 B 一致。

> Neither the manager nor the agents are available this afternoon.

### 規則 5｜過去反事實倒裝與情態完成式

Had + 主詞 + p.p. 可取代 If + 主詞 + had + p.p.；結果用 would/could have + p.p.。

> Had the shipment arrived on time, we would not have paid the storage fee.

sections.title: 03 Listening｜Overseas Replacement — Indirect Refusal
sections.markdown:
先閱讀題目，再聆聽內容並完成作答。

聽力稿：

> Customer: I ordered a replacement sensor for our Osaka office. Can you guarantee delivery by Friday morning?
> Agent: I wouldn't count on Friday morning just yet. The warehouse has not confirmed that the part is in stock.
> Customer: We have a demonstration at noon. Is there anything I can do to speed things up?
> Agent: If you send the serial-number photo by two this afternoon, I can request priority dispatch. That would still be a request, not a delivery guarantee.
> Customer: Should I return the faulty sensor now?
> Agent: Please keep it until we email you a return label. I'll check the inventory and send you an update before five.

sections.title: 04 Listening｜Support Plan Comparison and Conditional Activation
sections.markdown:
先閱讀題目，再聆聽內容並完成作答。

聽力稿：

> Woman: We need a support plan for six regional offices starting Monday, November second. It must include weekend coverage and a response within four hours, and our monthly cap is twelve hundred dollars.
> Man: The Essential plan is eight hundred forty dollars, but it responds within eight hours and excludes weekends. Flex is one thousand fifty dollars with a four-hour response, but no weekend support.
> Woman: What about Premier and Elite?
> Man: Premier costs eleven hundred eighty dollars, covers weekends, and promises a response within four hours. Elite has a two-hour response and weekend coverage, but costs twelve hundred sixty dollars.
> Woman: Premier seems to fit. Can we activate it today?
> Man: We can reserve the price, but activation for Monday requires a signed order form by Thursday at four. I haven't received it yet.

sections.title: 05 Listening｜Limited Return-Claim Deadline Extension
sections.markdown:
先閱讀題目，再聆聽內容並完成作答。

聽力稿：

> Announcer: This is an update for customers affected by the parcel-tracking outage on October twenty-sixth and twenty-seventh. The original return-claim deadline of Friday, October thirtieth, at five p.m. has been extended to Tuesday, November third, at noon, but only for customers who could not submit a claim during the outage. Eligible customers must upload photographs of the damaged item by Monday, November second, at six p.m. Customers who submitted a claim successfully before the outage do not need to submit it again. The standard return policy for other orders has not changed. For urgent safety concerns, call the product-safety team rather than using the online form.

sections.title: ⑥ Reading｜Service Agreement Amendments, Invoice Calculation and Written Acceptance
sections.markdown:
限時：**12 分 0 秒**。

### Harborline Solutions — Service Terms (issued October 12, 2026)

> HARBORLINE SOLUTIONS — REGIONAL SUPPORT AGREEMENT
Issued: October 12, 2026

First-month support is $190 per branch. A confirmed order covering six or more branches receives a 20% discount on the first-month support subtotal only. The discount does not apply to one-time charges: onboarding ($260), data migration ($180), or standard processing ($45). These charges appear on the first invoice. Subsequent monthly invoices cover support services according to the confirmed number of branches.

The service start date is Thursday, November 12. The standard deadline for a request to change the branch count is Tuesday, November 3, at 5 P.M. The deadline to cancel the agreement is also November 3 at 5 P.M. A branch-count change becomes effective only after Harborline issues written acceptance; sending a request or receiving an automated acknowledgment is not sufficient.

A later written amendment may supersede a specifically identified provision. Unless that amendment expressly says otherwise, every other provision of this agreement remains in effect. All dates and times in this agreement use Taipei time.

用途：參考文件

### Riverton Group — Confirmed Purchase Request (October 20, 2026)

> RIVERTON GROUP — PURCHASE REQUEST AND CONFIRMATION
Purchase request submitted: October 20, 2026
Confirmation received: October 21, 2026

Confirmed coverage: SIX regional branches, first month beginning November 12.
Services selected: standard onboarding, data migration, and standard processing.
Optional expedited onboarding: NOT selected.

The procurement team has approved a first-invoice budget of $1,450. Finance has asked the project lead to keep any additional charges within that amount. A manager has proposed reducing the coverage to five branches, but no accepted change is recorded in the purchasing system.

The original six-branch order is the only order currently marked CONFIRMED.

用途：參考文件

### Email Thread — Amendment and Optional Rush Service (October 28, 2026)

> FROM: contracts@harborline.example
TO: operations@riverton.example
DATE: Wednesday, October 28, 2026, 9:15 A.M.
SUBJECT: Amendment A — branch-count requests

We are extending ONLY the deadline to REQUEST A CHANGE IN BRANCH COUNT to Friday, November 6, at 3 P.M. Taipei time. This amendment supersedes the November 3 branch-count request deadline in the original agreement. The cancellation deadline remains November 3 at 5 P.M., and the service start date remains November 12. A change in branch count still requires our written acceptance.

We can also offer expedited onboarding on November 10 for an additional $75, which is not discounted. This option is available only after we receive your signed authorization. No rush service has been added to your confirmed order.

FROM: operations@riverton.example
TO: contracts@harborline.example
DATE: Wednesday, October 28, 2026, 10:05 A.M.
SUBJECT: RE: Amendment A

Thank you. We submitted a request to reduce the branch count to five, and the portal sent an automatic acknowledgment. Please confirm whether the change has been accepted. We are also considering expedited onboarding, but Finance has not authorized the additional charge.

FROM: contracts@harborline.example
TO: operations@riverton.example
DATE: Wednesday, October 28, 2026, 11:10 A.M.
SUBJECT: RE: Amendment A

The five-branch request is under review and has NOT been accepted. Your confirmed order remains at six branches. We will send a separate written acceptance if the request is approved. No expedited onboarding has been booked.

用途：參考文件

sections.title: ⑨ Day 48 小考
sections.markdown: 正式限時：**6 分 0 秒**。

sections.title: ⑩ 複習與錯題分類
sections.markdown:
回顧 **Day 45、Day 46、Day 47**。

### 複習重點
- **Day 45：書面接受**：區分 portal acknowledgment 與正式 written acceptance，說明哪個會使變更生效。
- **Day 46：跨部門核准**：列出未取得財務核准時，不能把加急費視為已確認服務的原因。
- **Day 47：限定期限延長**：比較「申請變更期限」與「取消期限」，辨認只被修正其中一項的情境。
- **Day 48：折扣與例外**：重算六間 $1,397、五間 $1,435、六間加急 $1,472；並標出哪一個方案目前有效。

### 錯題標籤
- `DETAIL`：明示細節辨認
- `IMPLICATION`：言外之意與間接拒絕
- `UNCERTAINTY`：尚未確認與不確定性
- `CONDITION`：條件成立才執行
- `NEXT_ACTION`：下一步行動
- `REQUIREMENT`：必要條件
- `CONSTRAINT`：限制條件
- `INTEGRATION`：跨來源資訊整合
- `BUDGET`：預算判斷
- `CALC`：金額計算
- `APPROVAL`：書面核准與生效
- `DEADLINE`：截止期限
- `UPDATE`：更新通知
- `TIME`：時間資訊
- `CAUSE`：事件原因
- `EXCEPTION`：例外適用
- `POLICY`：規章條款
- `DISCOUNT`：折扣範圍
- `THRESHOLD`：數量門檻
- `INFERENCE`：跨文件推論
- `WORD_FORM`：詞性與分詞
- `TIME_CLAUSE`：時間子句
- `TENSE`：時態
- `CONJUNCTION`：連接詞
- `PURPOSE`：目的
- `SUBJUNCTIVE`：要求式假設語氣
- `PASSIVE`：被動語態
- `PREPOSITION`：介系詞
- `CONTRAST`：轉折對比
- `SEQUENCE`：動作先後
- `PARTICIPLE`：分詞修飾
- `GERUND`：動名詞
- `AGREEMENT`：主詞動詞一致
- `GRAMMAR`：文法
- `ADVERB`：副詞
- `INFINITIVE`：不定詞
- `REPORTED_SPEECH`：間接引述
- `CONDITIONAL`：反事實條件句
- `INVERSION`：倒裝
- `COHESION`：篇章銜接
- `REFERENCE`：指涉關係
- `ELIGIBILITY`：適用資格

sections.title: ⑪ 今日作業
sections.markdown:
- 30 個單字複習兩輪，選擇 amendment、claimant、turnaround time、contingent 等 8 個撰寫商務例句。
- Listening 三組各練兩次；第一次不看逐字稿，第二次用 TTS 1.1 倍速並標記間接拒絕及 only if 等條件語。
- Reading 三份文件限時 12 分鐘，整理原條款、修正案、已確認訂單、待核准變更四欄。
- 重算六間／五間方案及加急服務費，說明 $75 為何不能直接列入已確認帳單。
- Part 5 15 題限時 4 分鐘，Part 6 4 題限時 3 分鐘；每題寫出支持答案的語法或篇章線索。
- 正式小考 12 題首次限時 6 分鐘，保留首次答案、正確題數、耗時及錯題 errorTags，供 Day 49 調整難度。

questions.prompt: What does the agent imply about delivery by Friday morning?

options.B: It is unlikely to be confirmed at this point.
options.C: The customer must collect the part in person.
options.D: It is scheduled for Thursday evening.

questions.explanation: 「I wouldn’t count on Friday morning」表示現在不能指望或保證週五上午送達，因為庫存尚未確認。

questions.prompt: What must the customer do to request priority dispatch?

options.C: Send a serial-number photo by 2 P.M.
options.D: Call the Osaka office after 5 P.M.

questions.explanation: 客服明確說明下午兩點前提供序號照片，才可提出優先出貨申請；申請不等於保證到貨。

questions.prompt: What will the agent most likely do before 5 P.M.?

options.D: Check inventory and provide an update.

questions.explanation: 最後一句承諾查詢庫存並在五點前回覆，並未承諾立即出貨。

quizzes.title: Support Plan Comparison and Conditional Activation

questions.prompt: Why is the Flex plan unsuitable?

options.A: It does not include weekend support.
options.C: Its response time is eight hours.

questions.explanation: Flex 雖符合四小時回覆與預算，但沒有週末支援。

questions.prompt: Why is the Elite plan not recommended?

options.B: It costs $60 more than the budget allows.
options.D: It requires an eight-hour response time.

questions.prompt: What is needed for the Premier plan to begin on Monday?

options.D: A signed order form by Thursday at 4 P.M.

questions.explanation: 客服指出須於週四 16:00 前收到簽署訂單；保留價格不代表服務已啟用。

questions.prompt: What caused the company to issue this announcement?
questions.explanation: 公告第一句指出 10 月 26–27 日的包裹追蹤系統中斷。

questions.prompt: What is the extended deadline for eligible return claims?
questions.explanation: 正式申訴延至 11/3 中午 12 點；11/2 18:00 是照片上傳期限，兩者不能混淆。

questions.prompt: What must eligible customers upload by November 2 at 6 P.M.?

questions.prompt: What should customers do if they already submitted a claim successfully?

options.A: File a new claim with a different account.
options.B: Visit a branch to verify the claim.
options.D: Keep the original claim; no resubmission is required.

quizzes.title: Service Agreement Amendments, Invoice Calculation and Written Acceptance

questions.prompt: What is the first-month support subtotal for the confirmed six-branch order after the discount?
How much is the confirmed first invoice, including all selected one-time charges?
questions.explanation: 折扣後支援 $912 + onboarding $260 + migration $180 + processing $45 = $1,397。

questions.prompt: If the five-branch change were accepted, what would the first invoice total be?
How much would the confirmed six-branch first invoice be WITH expedited onboarding, if that option were authorized?
questions.explanation: 現有第一張帳單 $1,397 + 未折扣的加急費 $75 = $1,472，超過 $1,450 預算 $22；但目前尚未核准。

questions.prompt: Which branch count is currently binding for the order?

options.A: Six, because the five-branch request has not been accepted in writing.
options.B: Five, because the portal acknowledged the request.
options.C: Five, because Amendment A automatically approves reductions.
options.D: Neither, because the service start date has changed.

questions.explanation: 自動回執僅代表收到申請，供應商明確表示五間申請仍在審查，已確認訂單仍為六間。

questions.prompt: What is the new deadline to request a change in branch count?
questions.explanation: Amendment A 僅將「變更分店數申請」期限改為 11/6 15:00。

questions.prompt: What is the deadline to cancel the agreement?
questions.explanation: 新版通知只取代變更分店數申請期限，明言取消期限仍為 11/3 17:00。

questions.prompt: Why has expedited onboarding not been added to the confirmed order?

options.B: It is included free of charge.
options.C: The service start date has been canceled.
options.D: The signed authorization has not been received.

questions.explanation: 加急服務需簽署授權；郵件指出財務部未核准額外費用、供應商尚未排定加急服務。

questions.prompt: Unless otherwise _____, the original cancellation deadline will remain in effect.
questions.explanation: 固定片語 unless otherwise stated，意為「除非另有說明」。

questions.prompt: The revised agreement will take effect once both parties _____ it.
questions.explanation: once 引導未來時間子句時用現在簡單式 sign。

questions.prompt: Please keep a copy of the receipt _____ a refund is requested later.
questions.explanation: in case 表「以防萬一」，保留收據以備日後申請退款。

questions.prompt: The director insisted that each complaint _____ reviewed within two business days.
questions.explanation: insist that 表要求時用原形動詞；被動為 be reviewed。

questions.prompt: _____ the shipping delay, the replacement parts arrived before the inspection.
questions.explanation: despite 後接名詞片語 the shipping delay；although 後需完整子句。

questions.prompt: The warranty can be extended, _____ the customer registers the product within 30 days.
questions.explanation: provided that 後接條件子句，表示只要在 30 天內註冊即可延長保固。

questions.prompt: The technician explained why the unit _____ functioning before the inspection.
questions.explanation: 故障先於過去的 explained，使用過去完成式 had stopped。

questions.prompt: The revised return conditions apply to all orders _____ after October 15.
questions.explanation: orders placed 為過去分詞後位修飾，表示「在 10/15 之後下的訂單」。

questions.prompt: The representative apologized _____ providing an incorrect tracking number.
questions.explanation: 固定搭配 apologize for + V-ing。

questions.prompt: Neither the regional manager nor the service agents _____ authorized to waive the charge.
questions.explanation: neither...nor 的動詞與較近主詞 agents（複數）一致。

questions.prompt: The updated form allows customers to submit claims more _____.
questions.explanation: 修飾動詞 submit 需副詞 efficiently。

questions.prompt: The replacement parts are expected _____ at the distribution center by Friday.
questions.explanation: be expected to + 原形動詞，表示預計到達。

questions.prompt: The customer asked whether the additional fee _____ on the next invoice.
questions.explanation: 過去時 asked 的間接引述，從當時看未來通常用 would appear。

questions.prompt: The agent suggested that the faulty device _____ at the customer’s office until pickup.
questions.explanation: suggest that 表建議時用原形動詞 remain。

questions.prompt: Had the shipment arrived on time, the warehouse _____ extra storage fees.
questions.explanation: Had + 主詞 + p.p. 為過去反事實倒裝，主句用 would not have incurred。

questions.prompt: Which sentence best completes blank [1]?

questions.prompt: Which phrase best completes blank [2]?
questions.explanation: 顧客是被通知的對象，未來會被 email 通知，因此用 will be notified。

questions.prompt: Which word best completes blank [3]?
questions.explanation: 前句說一般案件審查五個工作天，後句轉向緊急安全通報的特殊處理方式，需轉折 However。

options.B: The company no longer offers return shipping labels.
options.C: The claim will be automatically rejected after one day.

questions.prompt: Unless otherwise _____ in the amendment, the original terms remain valid.
questions.explanation: unless otherwise stated 為固定結構，指「除非修正案另有說明」。

questions.prompt: The revised plan will be activated as soon as Finance _____ the request.
questions.explanation: as soon as 引導未來時間子句時使用現在式 approves。

questions.prompt: The supervisor requested that the damaged units _____ inspected before dispatch.
questions.explanation: request that 的要求式假設語氣，使用 be inspected。

questions.prompt: Neither the supplier nor the warehouse employees _____ available after 6 P.M.
questions.explanation: neither...nor 就近一致，employees 為複數，故 are。

options.A: The delivery time is already confirmed.

options.C: Ask the customer to send a serial-number photo.

options.B: Register again with a different email address.

How much of the approved budget remains?

options.B: A customer whose case number was issued on October 28.
